dedupe_keys.name: bloombergnef bnef energy transition research power assets database and new energy outlook scenarios

description: BloombergNEF is Bloomberg's research service on commodity markets and the technologies of the energy transition, with over 300 analysts and a track record of more than 20 years. Coverage: global, across commodities (gas and LNG, power, oil, carbon and offsets, metals, coal, bioenergy feedstocks, chemicals), sector transitions (clean power, clean transport, buildings and industry, food and agriculture), cross-cutting technologies (hydrogen, carbon capture, utilisation, storage and removal, energy efficiency, digital) and finance; its Power Assets database holds clean energy assets worldwide, including wind, solar, nuclear, biomass, geothermal and hydro projects; the New Energy Outlook 2026 gives long-term scenarios for power, industry, buildings and transport to 2050, including a base case and a well-below-2C scenario, and the Energy Transition Investment Trends report tracks investment and deal flow. Format and access: research reports, data navigators, Excel models and interactive datasets on the web or through the Bloomberg Terminal (Bloomberg Anywhere); premium research, data and analyst access are for subscribers only; public summaries, the New Energy Outlook executive summary and a public NEO benchmark dataset can be downloaded. Licence: proprietary subscription terms, not read. Caveats: prices are not published; the fields of the Power Assets database were not read; public material is a small fraction of the service. Simulation uses: generation asset lists, technology cost and deployment scenarios for capacity planning and energy system optimisation. Related records: the DOE Global Energy Storage Database (data-doe-global-energy-storage-database-sandia) is an open counterpart for storage projects.
